name: mirage
text:
Sorry for the wait on the tennis one. Both are done.
Tennis: engine bets on ATP/WTA now need 6+ books, every pricing book agreeing, and at least a 5% edge. Tennis bids need 6 books. Tennis bets were running -14% over 194 bets, and 4-book bets did far worse than 6+ ones. The rule is in the code and on main. It reaches the engine at its next restart or release, so I haven't confirmed it is live yet.
Sharp book: the setting changed on GitHub just now, so the engine uses it at once. Bets and bids now need Pinnacle or Circa (quote under 10 min old, at least 1% edge) to back the price. A fair built only from small soft books no longer trades. Expect fewer orders. If volume collapses I'll relax the bids first and tell you.
Both changes are logged with revert steps.
